newsitem.title: USA: Maine Yankee says nuke may restart over weekend.
newsitem.headline: Maine Yankee says nuke may restart over weekend.

text.p: The 910 megawatt Maine Yankee nuclear power plant in Wiscasset, Maine, could resume electricity output over the weekend after a shutdown for electrical repairs, a plant spokeswoman said.
"It would be more like over the weekend," spokeswoman Leann Diehl said when asked about a tentative restart date set by the Nuclear Regulatory Commission (NRC) in a report.
The NRC said in its daily plant status report that Maine Yankee was expected to restart December 13.
The plant was shut Dec 5 for the repairs.
"We have not yet begun to return to service, we are still looking for other similar (electrical) cable problems," Diehl said Thursday.
Maine Yankee is 38 percent owned by Central Maine Power Co, 20 percent each by New England Electric System and Northeast Utilities and 22 percent by other New England utilities.
